songs.title: Reluctant Auteur
songs.focus: Instrumental passage / 3 active musical roles / 5 active stems

editing.protocol: Independent one-field edits from the same predicted scene. No network re-inference. All other fields and objects unchanged. Discrete pre-rendered examples, not a live renderer.

renderer: HOA2 -> 11 virtual speakers -> soft-top4 KEMAR binaural
normalization: One common source gain and shared peak-safety attenuation per passage, across original, all conditions and edits. No per-variant loudness/tonal matching; no crossfades or repeated audio.
source_path: Labeled native 44.1 kHz M/S stems; original is their stereo sum. No source-separator inference.
inference: Full-passage waveform encoding and temporal pooling; one fixed metadata scene per condition. No retraining or time-varying metadata.
selection: Replacement curation from fixed artist-disjoint MoisesDB test/validation splits, excluding all three old songs. 16-24 second beat-group passages. Voice requires >=80% active 100-ms frames, no inactive run >0.70 s, >=30% activity in every sliding 1-s window, >=35% role energy and >=-3 dB vocal/accompaniment energy at 300-3500 Hz. Activity is an energy proxy, not phonetic annotation. Ensemble requires >=5 roles (>1.5% role energy) and >=8 stems (>0.5% individual-stem energy). No SceneUpmix-versus-rule score is used. Curated demonstration, not an evaluation set or perceptual validation; dataset genres retained.

song_replacements.selection: One replacement passage from the existing fixed MoisesDB artist-disjoint held-out analyses. The original vocal-role waveform must be exactly silent in the cached energy analysis, including 0.4-second context on each side, then verified again at native sample rate during export. No stems are removed or muted. Beat-group duration 16-24 seconds; at least three active roles (>1.5% role energy), four active stems (>0.5% stem energy), and 20% energy in guitar/keys/strings/winds/other. Rank by active instrumentation and energy diversity, not model-versus-rule scores. Curated demo passage, not a new evaluation set. Genre retains the dataset label; instrumental describes this passage.
